description: 1000 bots at Lumbridge with the bots' chat model loaded and replying every 10 s (Think first) for 30 minutes, with the app's page collections (PageMemory, every 30 s) and the music's render-ahead limit (client patch 0034). Activity Monitor samples (3 s) now and then; the phone's Web Inspector can record alongside. Run with --bots 1000. 2026-10-27 (iPhone 13 mini): no kill, 181 replies; WebContent 838 MB at 15 min, 950 at 28 (the page's heap flat at about 190; the rest climbs about 3.6 MB a minute).
